heroHeadline: Super Bowl LX Halftime Show Sweeps 7 Creative Arts Emmys — Most Ever for a Halftime Performance
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny's Apple Music Super Bowl LX Halftime Show won 7 of its 9 nominations at the Creative Arts Emmy Awards in Los Angeles on September 5, becoming the most-awarded halftime performance in Emmy history and giving Bad Bunny his first Emmy. The show took Outstanding Variety Special (Live) — the first Spanish-language program ever to win that category — plus music direction, choreography, sound mixing, lighting design, technical direction, and directing. Its 9 total nominations, announced in July, already stood as a record for a music special, surpassing the mark Lady Gaga set in 2017. The win adds to a run that includes a 2026 Grammy and Latin Grammy, and follows a quiet stretch in Puerto Rico politics: since the September 1 Senate hearing where Proyecto Esencia's developers defended the $2.5 billion Cabo Rojo project — the same one Bad Bunny demanded be "canceled" from the Hiram Bithorn stage — no further hearing or ruling has surfaced.
